events.title: Hocus Pocus
events.description:
Get It Right Music in association with BK One Productions is proud to present our late summer/early fall music documentary and horror film movies (yes, those two things go together, and yes, we ARE wondering why you are asking!). Watch fan favorites on our 16-foot wide LED video wall and enjoy the film in full concert sound!
You have reached the ticketing page for Hocus Pocus!
Hollywood superstar Bette Midler (Beaches) joins Sarah Jessica Parker (Honeymoon in Vegas) and Kathy Najimy (Sister Act) as three outlandishly wild witches who return from 17th Century Salem for a night of zany fun and comic chaos. After they’re accidentally conjured up by some unsuspecting pranksters, the tricky 300-year-old trio sets out to cast a spell on the town and reclaim their youth – but first they must outwit three pesky kids who are determined to foil their scheme! Loaded with bewitching laughs and magical special effects, HOCUS POCUS is an outrageous comedy that’s sure to entertain everyone.
Event Info
Film: Hocus Pocus
Date: October 24th, 2026
Doors: 1:30pm
Film start: 2:00pm
RSVP: Free or strongly encourage guaranteed $20 two-drink included RSVP.
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn, New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The selection of music documentaries was curated by audience vote from our summer concert series and the horror movies came from out of our brains!
Seating for these screenings are limited to 150 people or so (with slightly more for the music docs so peeps can throw down appropriately.
Fans who purchase the 2 drink guaranteed RSVP will be guaranteed entry, natch! So you will save money at the bar, AND make sure you aren’t shut out!
This event is free with RSVP, ages 8 and up are welcome. There will be drink specials, all night, as well.
Limited seating (about 100-125 seats), tons of standing room. No strollers.
No outside beverages. There will be drink specials all night long from our courtyard bar.
While we do our best to gauge the number of RSVPs, entry is still on a first-come, first-served basis, so please arrive early! Once we hit capacity, we will only let people in on an in and out basis! Fans who purchase the 2 drink RSVP at check-out will be guaranteed entry!
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.

events.title: Barrel Age Your Own Sake — A Brooklyn Kura Workshop Class
events.description:
*What You’ll Create
A functional 2-liter oak barrel, coopered from scratch — same craft, same tools, same afternoon of assembling staves and hoops, cutting crozes on the router table, and charring the interior until it’s ready for spirits. This time, what goes in it isn’t whiskey. It’s rice, koji, yeast, and water, aged into something you helped choose.
*The Tasting Flight
A sake expert from Brooklyn Kura walks you through a flight of three sakes and a shochu, all brewed or distilled right here in Industry City, all selected because they take well to a little time in wood. The lineup changes with the seasons, but here’s what’s been on the table:
Grand Prairie — a Junmai Ginjo built around white peach, jasmine, and toasted rice.
Occidental — a dry-hopped Junmai, bringing out lychee, grapefruit, and cherry that age into deeper dried-fruit notes. Tidal — a fuller-bodied
Junmai, all steamed rice, apple, and cereal bran.
Kura Shochu — distilled from the leftover sake lees, rich with fig and custard and a rice umami built for barrel aging.
Finishing the Night at Kura
Your barrel’s made, your glass is empty — Brooklyn Kura is a short walk across Industry City, and your Craftsman Ave ticket gets you a discount on sake or shochu to take home and age. They’ve got a full kitchen too: mac and cheese, little smoky sausages, house-made focaccia. Good reason to stay a while longer.

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.
